source_note_content:
Danish's strategic direction from 2026-06-08 standup:

Agent Platform role across 3 agent families:
1. Admin agent family - currently strongest role
2. Deals agent family - self-sufficient, early adopters, some net new requirements coming
3. GTM agent family - needs deep support from us (observability, telemetry, alerting, monitoring, UI/UX)

Role: SWAT team - strategically step in, address specific concern, get out. GTM takes priority.

New roadmap elements to introduce:
- Security
- Observability / telemetry
- Toolkit robustness and flexibility for newer integration patterns
- Agent memories not being utilized optimally
- No reinforcement learning happening - agents don't utilize previous conversations

Merger context: renewed focus on AI/agents and pace. Plan B (stay independent) in play while merger is uncertain. Expect more scrutiny on pace and quality.

source_note_content:
**Meeting assets for Danish - Ram 1:1** 



## Quick recap

This meeting was a feedback discussion between Ram and Danish regarding Hemant's performance as PM on the agent platform team. Danish provided positive feedback on Hemant's effectiveness with design teams, customer-facing features, and team rapport, but noted areas for improvement including technical alignment with the platform's capabilities and stronger partnerships with other teams like search and memory. Ram shared that he's considering restructuring the PM role, potentially splitting it into two positions - one focused on UX aspects and another on more technical backend work with Rishabh. They discussed upcoming organizational changes where teams will need to align their work more closely with AI agent initiatives, with Brigu planning to review fall launch priorities and potentially reallocate resources. Ram also provided feedback to Danish, praising his strong technical abilities and management skills while emphasizing the need for better proactive communication to shift perceptions about the team's impact across the organization.

## Next steps

### Danish

- [Work with Hemant (and optionally Rishabh) to prepare a clear, compelling story for how current/future work aligns with Brigu's agent/agent platform vision, in preparation for upcoming ED sessions where resource allocation will be evaluated.](https://tasks.zoom.us/?meetingId=ZzuT1%2F3xTTeM2iPYFCprrg%3D%3D&stepId=598c0761-5ba9-11f1-9b4f-d64545e70e1d)
- [Push for more proactive team visibility—organize and execute regular show-and-tell sessions (e.g., PM all-hands, workshops) to communicate team progress and impact to partner teams and leadership; report back to Ram by end of week on actions taken.](https://tasks.zoom.us/?meetingId=ZzuT1%2F3xTTeM2iPYFCprrg%3D%3D&stepId=598c0a59-5ba9-11f1-b58a-d64545e70e1d)
- [Draft and share a recommendation for a one-time bonus or appreciation for front-end engineer Gonick, and coordinate with Michelle to move this forward.](https://tasks.zoom.us/?meetingId=ZzuT1%2F3xTTeM2iPYFCprrg%3D%3D&stepId=598c0ccd-5ba9-11f1-a5a1-d64545e70e1d)
- [Review and prioritize the list of E2E items and other pending topics with the team as soon as possible, and coordinate with Ram and Sarosh as needed.](https://tasks.zoom.us/?meetingId=ZzuT1%2F3xTTeM2iPYFCprrg%3D%3D&stepId=598c1131-5ba9-11f1-9c1a-d64545e70e1d)
- [Continue to monitor and provide feedback on team morale and engagement, and escalate any issues or suggestions to Ram and leadership as appropriate.](https://tasks.zoom.us/?meetingId=ZzuT1%2F3xTTeM2iPYFCprrg%3D%3D&stepId=598c156b-5ba9-11f1-b4d3-d64545e70e1d)

### Ram

- [Secure a 1-hour meeting slot with Sarosh next week to review and align on fall launch priorities and ensure tight alignment with Brigu's vision (before leaving for vacation).](https://tasks.zoom.us/?meetingId=ZzuT1%2F3xTTeM2iPYFCprrg%3D%3D&stepId=598c013a-5ba9-11f1-af8b-d64545e70e1d)
- [Keep Danish updated on any feedback or changes relevant to team morale, resource allocation, or organizational structure, especially as they pertain to the agent platform team.](https://tasks.zoom.us/?meetingId=ZzuT1%2F3xTTeM2iPYFCprrg%3D%3D&stepId=598c0f06-5ba9-11f1-b4b1-d64545e70e1d)
- [Formalize and communicate the potential reorganization of the PM role (splitting UX-focused and technical PM responsibilities) within the next week, including communication to Sarosh and impacted team members.](https://tasks.zoom.us/?meetingId=ZzuT1%2F3xTTeM2iPYFCprrg%3D%3D&stepId=598c1353-5ba9-11f1-a644-d64545e70e1d)

## Summary

### Performance Feedback and Technology Alignment

Danish provided feedback on Hemant's performance, noting his effectiveness in design and UX work, proactive approach with the team, and good rapport with team members. However, Danish identified a concern about a mismatch between the platform's technology capabilities and its focus on customer-facing features, which sometimes detracts from serving internal agents like GTM and deals agents. The discussion was cut off mid-conversation when Ram asked for additional constructive criticism.

### Tech Partnership Restructuring Discussion

Danish discussed challenges with tech partnerships, particularly highlighting weaker collaboration with the search and memory team on features like conversation history search functionality. Ram shared feedback from the design team about struggles with grounding in customer scenarios and expressed concerns about the current PM's technical adequacy for the team's evolving needs. Ram proposed potentially restructuring the team into two PM roles - one focused on UX and the other on technical aspects - with Rishabh potentially taking on a more technical partnership role.

### PM Team Restructuring Discussion

Ram discussed plans to restructure the PM team, potentially moving Rishabh to a different PM role, and sought Danish's feedback on the proposal. Danish expressed support for the idea, citing Rishabh's strong collaborative work on agent memories and the benefits of keeping related components within the same organization. Ram also mentioned ongoing challenges with Tony's transition from team management to individual contributor status, particularly his difficulty managing upwards, and noted that Utsav is leaving the company.

### AI Reorganization Strategy Discussion

Ram debriefed Danish on a recent meeting with Brigu, where they discussed an upcoming reorganization focused on AI agent initiatives. Brigu emphasized that all work must align with either agent development or the broader agentic story, with resources being reallocated based on alignment with this vision. Danish expressed concerns about prioritization and the need to converge their current technology approach, while Ram suggested they should prepare to present their work's alignment with the new vision in upcoming one-hour ED sessions. They agreed to schedule additional time with Soros to review and prioritize their fall launch funding decisions.

### Team Morale and Retention Discussion

Ram discussed team morale challenges across the organization and mentioned that Brigu is seeking feedback and ideas from team leaders about potential issues. Danish shared that his team had a difficult situation with a non-performing resource who has now left the company, and he is recommending a front-end engineer named Gonick for a one-time bonus or appreciation since his promotion would not occur until November. Ram confirmed that retention bonus money typically returns to the pool and suggested Danish make the case for Gonick's bonus to Michelle.

### Team Perception Management Strategy

Ram provided feedback to Danish, praising his technical skills and team performance while highlighting the need for better perception management across the organization. Ram emphasized that the team needs to proactively showcase their work through regular presentations and updates to leadership, as they haven't done so since December and this is creating perception issues about their value and impact. Ram assigned Danish the action of organizing a team presentation by the end of the week and requested regular updates to help improve visibility for leadership.
source_note_title: Ram and Danish 1:1 follow-ups

The note also captures multiple follow-ups for Danish and Ram around visibility, prioritization, morale, and a bonus recommendation.
